reviews.title: Nothing to Complain About
reviews.comment: I bought this mat for my work desk because of the cheaper price compared to others i have purchased before. The quality is just as good if not better than the one i have on my computer desk at home. Although it was rolled up, it lays perfectly flat right away. It is easy to clean, comfortable, and feels nice on my wrist when typing. The color is exactly what i was looking for and seems like it will last. I will update if the edge stitching frays after a few months. Highly recommendable so far.
reviews.author: a hansen
